name: com.unicostudio.buildsystem
description: Single-panel build automation for Unico mobile games: reload-safe build jobs, pre-flight checks, versioned Addressables content updates, build-scoped define/package stripping, artifact naming, crash recovery, and a headless CI entry point.

samples.description: Host-side samples: keystore passwords from environment variables (applied on editor load, BEFORE preflight — deliberately not a hook) and a post-success symbols-upload [UnicoBuildStep] skeleton.

PostSuccess step wiring com.unicostudio.versiontracker (>= 1.6.0 required) into the build result: verifies the tracker metadata was freshly written for this run and attaches it as a Metadata artifact. Compiles only with the tracker installed.
